# VoruVoru

> Independent chibi art and creator asset commission website. Prices are in USD. Scope and availability must be confirmed by the owner.

## Site information
- [Home](https://voruvoru.github.io/): Commission tiers and creator guides.
- [About](https://voruvoru.github.io/about.html): Brand and contact information.
- [FAQ](https://voruvoru.github.io/faq.html): Commission preparation and usage questions.
- [Request information](https://voruvoru.github.io/tos.html): Confirm scope and payment terms in writing.
- [Art usage](https://voruvoru.github.io/license.html): Personal and commercial usage questions.
- [Privacy](https://voruvoru.github.io/privacy.html): Data and local draft information.

## Accuracy notes
Portfolio images have not yet been uploaded. No client counts, ratings or paid partnerships are asserted. Automated checkout and inquiry submission require configuration. llms.txt is a supplemental plain-text guide; it does not guarantee indexing, AI citation or ranking.
